title: bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2: single-frame fused-norm cyclotomic square in a Frobenius-class rho

claims.statement: For a uniform nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 and a uniform z in GT, the Frobenius-class distinguished-point walk in proof.md returns Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z with probability at least 0.39. The walk squares with the single-frame fused-norm cyclotomic schedule (leaf bodies of blst sqr_382x / redc_mont_384 / add_mod_384x384, one frame) and otherwise multiplies by a twisted table entry. Total classical work is at most 2^(25157/200) target-group-operation equivalents, including preprocessing, cycle escapes, distinguished-point handling, verification and output. Peak memory is at most 2^74 bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^77 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in the total. Nonuniform advice is 0 bytes. Heuristics H1, H5 and H7 are stated in proof.md. This is a classical cold attack.

experiments.purpose: Check that the four coefficients retained by the six-square block match the nine-square cyclotomic formula on random tower elements, and that the submitted score is strictly below 31447421/250000.
